trigger: Remnant picket on the Hwy 210 bridge. Searchlight in the snow.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Sandbags on the bridge. A searchlight sweeping the snow. Kessler's last loyalists, and the last diesel.

nodes.speaker: ruiz
nodes.text: Shift change is at the hour. Eight-minute gap on the east end. I built that schedule.

nodes.speaker: ruiz
nodes.text: We go quiet, in a line, no lights. If anyone coughs, we go anyway.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: No way around but the thin ice downstream, or straight through.

nodes.speaker: kessler
nodes.text: [Loudspeaker] Civilian column, you are approaching a federal position. State your number and purpose.

choices.text: Twenty people. Freezing. Let us pass.

nodes.speaker: kessler
nodes.text: [Loudspeaker] Negative. Leave your fuel and medical supplies at the marker, then pass.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: You leave it at the marker. They let you pass. A soldier on the sandbags lifts a hand, ashamed.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Eight minutes. Twenty people. Nobody coughs. On the far side, Ruiz is shaking.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: The ice groans under the column. Everyone gets across. The sled nearly doesn't.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Muzzle flashes in the snow. Kessler's voice on the speaker, perfectly calm, counting casualties.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Jay Cooke. The trees are black. Somewhere ahead, wolves.
